description: Net present value of a list of cash flows at a discount rate per period. The first flow is at time 0 and is NOT discounted (the usual textbook NPV; a spreadsheet NPV() function discounts the first value one period, so its result is this one divided by 1 + rate). Money received is positive, money paid is negative. ratePerPeriod must match the spacing of the flows (a monthly rate for monthly flows). To find the rate that makes NPV zero use workflow.run_irr. Use when user asks "is this project worth doing at a 10% cost of capital?" or "what is the NPV of these cash flows?". Returns: npv, discountedFlows, pvOfInflows, pvOfOutflows, undiscountedSum, periods.

cashFlows.description: Cash flow at time 0, 1, 2, ... (e.g. [-1000, 500, 500, 500]); use 0 for an empty period

ratePerPeriod.description: Discount rate per period as a fraction (0.1 = 10% per period), above -100%, at most 1e6

name: workflow.run_npv
title: Npv
